products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a nonprofit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and art application. The foundation describes its work as community-governed, with development and direction shaped by contributors and users rather than commercial interests.

The foundation's AI-related offering is tracked as Krita AI, which the site positions as an open-source digital art tool with local AI plugins that operate without cloud dependency. This means any AI-assisted features run on the user's own hardware rather than through external services, which the foundation appears to present as a point of distinction.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP server registrations, or SEC records are associated with the Krita Foundation in the held facts.
